title: Deductible Kept on Recovery of Stolen Property under the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim is re-settled after stolen property is recovered, the entitlement after recovery is the missing-property total less the deductible kept on recovery, never below zero. The deductible kept on recovery is measured from the date of the latest adjuster assessment of the claim to the handling date, in calendar days:

| Calendar days from the latest assessment to the handling date | Deductible kept on recovery |
| --- | --- |
| 15 or fewer | nothing — the recovery first restores the deductible the tenant bore |
| more than 15 and at most the level's recovered-property repayment period (30 at every coverage level) | the full re-settlement deductible multiplied by the missing-property total and divided by the pre-recovery total |
| more than that | the full re-settlement deductible |

The full re-settlement deductible is the deductible the re-settlement charges in full.

## Boundary days (hypothetical)

Day 15 after the latest assessment keeps nothing; day 16 keeps the proportion; day 30 still keeps the proportion; day 31 keeps the full re-settlement deductible.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Missing-property total 1,600.00; pre-recovery total 3,500.00; full re-settlement deductible 140.00.
- Handled 10 days after the latest assessment: nothing kept, entitlement after recovery 1,600.00.
- Handled 22 days after: 140.00 multiplied by 1,600.00 and divided by 3,500.00 is 64.00 kept; entitlement 1,536.00.
- Handled 45 days after: 140.00 kept; entitlement 1,460.00.
